pages.useful_because: The homepage is the only page that puts all five Ledco Plumbing services side by side with a symptom guide that matches what a Seminole homeowner is actually seeing (one slow drain, several drains backing up, a jumping water bill, a split pipe after a hard freeze, a rumbling water heater) to the service that fixes it. It also names the owner, Mickey Ledbetter, shows the 316 E Oak Ave office on a map with directions, explains what to do in the first minutes of a leak (close the main shutoff), and walks through what happens after the estimate form is sent. Service pages go deep on one problem each; this page routes the visitor to the right one.

pages.useful_because: The services hub is the only page that tells a caller, service by service, what to have ready before phoning Ledco Plumbing (which drains are slow, the water heater label, what the water meter does, where the sewer cleanout is, who can open a commercial building) and why each detail matters. It also explains how a job is priced (after the problem is seen, before work starts) and what changes the price, and links all five service pages in one grid.

pages.useful_because: This page tells a Seminole homeowner how to tell a fixture clog from a main-line problem (four warning signs), what usually clogs each drain in the house and a habit that prevents it (a drain-by-drain table), why older Seminole houses with cast-iron drain pipe re-clog, and exactly how a Ledco drain visit runs. The homepage only routes to this service; sibling pages cover other problems.
